name: Weather Desk
description: Your places, current estimates, 48-hour planning, 16-day forecasts and air quality, with historical, marine and river exploration.
author: Vakyartha

open-meteo__geocoding.reason: Search for a city or postal code when adding a place.

open-meteo__weather_forecast.reason: Refresh current conditions and daily forecasts for saved places.

open-meteo__air_quality.reason: Include air-quality readings when that source is enabled in app preferences.

open-meteo__weather_archive.reason: Read a historical date range when you explicitly choose Explore.

open-meteo__marine_weather.reason: Read marine conditions when you explicitly choose Explore.

open-meteo__flood_forecast.reason: Read river-discharge forecasts when you explicitly choose Explore.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: List Weather Desk's saved places, stable place IDs, source retrieval times and read errors. Reads saved state only.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Read saved weather datasets with returned metric units, local source times, retrieval times, errors and freshness. Does not fetch new weather.

placeId.description: Stable ID from list_places; omit for the selected place.

tools.name: get_weather_briefing
tools.description: Read the saved weather programme for Listen and Watch. It uses the same canonical records as the app and does not synthesize speech or refresh sources.

skills.name: weather-desk-reader
skills.description: Read Weather Desk's saved forecasts and source times using the canonical weather procedure
